finite_geometry.patch_method: Original-edge adjacency; coplanar connected patches with adjacent-normal dot >1-1e-8 and plane residual <2e-5 mm. Minimum-max-distance path, max 30 edges, each finite edge within 2 mm of actual first chord. Every chosen patch original triangle normal must be strictly inward by >1e-7. Opposing faces are never collapsed. Infinite plane intersection distance is separately labelled and never substituted for a finite shared edge.
finite_geometry.warning: Mixed chains are explicitly not classified as single convex edges. Actual original finite edges and every chain triangle normal are retained; infinite plane intersection lines are separately labelled and never treated as finite shared edges.

full_original_triangle_winding.arithmetic: long double; compensated sum of every original triangle solid angle
full_original_triangle_winding.roles: For every original short and its selected root: source outside, first-material midpoint, complete first-air midpoint. Two additional support witnesses included separately. Full continuity is additionally established by all-original-triangle long-double intersections and positive-length coplanar interval clipping.

limitations: Finite samples and specified source-derived connections only. Raw short normals and failed pair/triple attempts remain. No global wall or manufacturing-tolerance certification. Null first_air means unbounded exterior air without a subsequent hit, not zero thickness.
status: main reviewer accepted specific bounded short-root and side-connected slab evidence; no opening exception
